targets.title: Asymmetrical Body Perception: A Possible Role for Neural Body Representations.
targets.evidence_quote: Code to reproduce claims g42d91, m52v4z, my2oxz was written from scratch. One script was written to reproduce all analyses.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: Although formally none of the claims reproduced, all mismatches are in p-rep values. The mismatches are either negligibly small (0.01 p-rep difference), or in two cases p-rep were equal to 0.5 even though t-values and p-values were different, which could be caused by a copy-paste error. None of the conclusions are affected by the non-reproduction of p-rep values.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: One script was written to reproduce all analyses.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Two p-rep discrepancies exceed negligible rounding and are classified as non-reproductions, although substantive conclusions survive. Only original computations were checked; no alternative specifications were tested.
